title: fix(console): record loading shows no internal id in the drawer title and no false 0 related count
body:

_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwBTDAJKyXUan6fJCKsZUf5Pv)_

Fixes #36235

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读
- 用户在网速慢时打开记录：侧边抽屉的标题先显示占位条，不再闪出一串内部编号；相关列表在数量读到之前不显示数字，不再先显示一个假的「0」。
- 属于记录页体验收尾，替在慢网络下看记录的所有用户解决误导显示。
- 出错时最坏是标题或数字多停留一会儿占位，数据本身不受影响，可直接撤回。
- 无。

## What changes
Premise measured on 844218f5, by half:

- **Full record page — already right on main.** The breadcrumb's record crumb names the record by its object label until the read lands (objectstack#35412, `recordCrumbName`), and the existing pin `the breadcrumb while the record is read (objectstack#35412)` in `RecordDetailView.topBar-27524.test.tsx` asserts exactly this card's full-page clause ("no `#`"). The page body is `SkeletonDetail` while loading. No code change here. The other `#shortId` spellings the card names are not load states: `originFrom` / the phone back label / the trail crumbs read `parent.t` from the URL trail (`?from=`), which does not wait on any read — the short id there is the fallback for a trail entry written without a title, kept. The shell `AppHeader` record crumb (`routeTitle = … || #shortId`) is not mounted on a record route at any width (`showHeader` is off: desktop draws no top bar, a phone's record page owns its bar), so it is not drawn.
- **Record drawer / side preview — changed.** The bar's record row drew `titleOf(current)` = `#<shortId>` until the record header claimed the bar, i.e. for the whole read. It now draws a `Skeleton` placeholder (`data-record-drawer-title-pending`) until it has a title. To keep the loaded-record-with-no-name case, `RecordDetailView` (embedded) now reports the short id itself once it holds the record and has nothing to name it by (`paneRecordTitle`, from `recordCrumbName`); a read in flight reports nothing. Ancestor crumbs keep `titleOf` (they were drawn before, so they reported).
- **Related list count badge — changed.** `recordCount` fell back to `relatedData.length` (0) while the first read was in flight, so both the full list header badge and the compact card's `data-related-card-count` chip read 「0」. A new `countPending` (no count answers, first read in flight, no rows yet, no windowed total) draws no badge/chip; the compact card's tooltip uses the plain "View all" meanwhile. A list whose read lands empty still draws 0. The record tab badges (`RecordPageColumns`) already use `null` until counted — unchanged.

## Tests
- New `RelatedList.countPending-36235.test.tsx`: list header draws no badge while `find` is pending, then `2`; CONTROL empty read draws `0`; compact uncounted card draws no chip while pending, then `2`.
- New describe `the pane's bar while the record is read (objectstack#36235)` in `RecordDetailView.topBar-27524.test.tsx` (real `RecordStackDrawer` + embedded `RecordDetailView`, deferred `findOne`): placeholder present, no `[data-record-drawer-title]`, bar text has no `#r-1`; after the read the header H1 names the record.
- Three existing pins that asserted the in-flight row read `#L-1` / `#T-1` (`recordDrawerStack-26679`, `recordDrawerStack.rootStepper-26679`) now assert the placeholder — the old assertion was this card's defect.

<details><summary>Runs (head 05f7dfd11a code; a90612da adds the changeset only)</summary>

- Touched files: `Test Files 4 passed (4) · Tests 36 passed (36)`, lock `VERDICT command-exit 0`.
- `packages/plugin-detail/` whole package: `Test Files 417 passed | 1 skipped (418) · Tests 3916 passed | 18 skipped`.
- app-shell record surface (`views/RecordDetailView*`, `__tests__/recordDrawer*`, `ObjectView.recordDrawer*`): `Test Files 103 passed (103) · Tests 868 passed (868)`. The rest of app-shell (≈2.4k files) is declared to CI's Test UI shards.
- Ablation A — `countPending` forced `false` (`ablation-replace`, anchor 1→0, blob 6ecd77e1→cef57eaa): `2 failed | 1 passed` — both pending cases red, the empty-read CONTROL green; restored, blob == HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty.
- Ablation B — drawer row back to `titleOf(current)` (anchor 1→0, blob 92e94a22→c7dafb92): `4 failed | 29 passed` — the new pane pin and the three updated pins red; restored, blob == HEAD.
- Full-page clause: covered by the existing objectstack#35412 pin (no code change on that path).
</details>

## Acceptance notes
- Browser reach (throttled network, page + drawer): NOT MEASURED at PR open — the reading goes in the os-dev-report comment on this PR.
- Local `type-check` for both packages: NOT MEASURED (needs the `@object-ui/*` dist closure, not built here); declared to CI `Type Check UI`.
- Deep-linked drawer ancestors that were never drawn still show `#shortId` in the trail (they never load at all — not a load state; noted, not filed).

## Verification
Two minutes: open any record with related lists in DevTools "Slow 3G", from a list (drawer) and by URL (page). Expect a grey bar where the drawer title goes, then the name; related list headers show no number until the rows arrive.

Read first: `RelatedList.tsx` `countPending` (risk: a refetch with zero rows hides the badge briefly), `recordDrawerStack.tsx` record row, `RecordDetailView.tsx` `paneRecordTitle` effect (moved below `recordCrumbName`, above every early return).
